notes.title: Blueberry pancake recipe
notes.text: Martin's Saturday blueberry pancakes use 150 grams of flour, 1 egg, and a cup of milk. They cook 3 minutes per side in a dry skillet.

notes.title: Pepper's vet visit
notes.text: The fictional terrier mix Pepper has a checkup with Dr. Lang at Cedar Mills Animal Desk on 2026-08-14 at 10:00.

notes.title: Library evening shift
notes.text: Martin works evening shifts at Cedar Mills public library from 16:00 to 21:00 on weekdays.

notes.title: Book club pick
notes.text: The Cedar Mills book club is reading The Night River by I. Elwood in September.

notes.title: Spare key location
notes.text: A spare key for the garden shed is under the blue flowerpot, not under the mat.

notes.title: Ferry timetable
notes.text: The 7:15 ferry from Cedar Mills jetty was cancelled on 2026-05-02; the next listed boat was 8:00.

notes.title: Wagon loan
notes.text: Jordan Hale borrowed a foldable wagon on Friday and promised to return it Sunday noon.

notes.title: Invoice North Pine
notes.text: Invoice INV-204 from North Pine Software is USD 240.00 dated 2026-04-12 for a calendar plugin, paid by Mira Chen.

notes.title: Cedar Tools hammers

notes.title: River Coach booking

notes.title: Hillside workshop fee
notes.text: Hillside Services gardening workshop fee of USD 19.99 on 2026-03-30 was rejected. Requester: Priya Shah.

notes.text: Blue Kettle Cafe charged USD 8.00 on 2026-07-04 for tea. No deal id.

notes.title: Bake sale
notes.text: The library bake sale is on May 3 at 5:30 p.m. in the lobby, optional potluck style.

notes.title: Room B12 meeting
notes.text: A sample review meeting moved to room B12 at 3:00 p.m.; attendees should bring the cedar sample.

notes.title: Library card expiry
notes.text: A patron library card expires on 12 March and can be renewed at the desk.

notes.title: Widget shipment
notes.text: An order of 12 widgets should ship to 400 Maple Street and costs USD 48.50.

notes.title: Pamphlet draft
notes.text: An 8-page pamphlet draft is finished; the author asked whether to send a paper copy or a PDF.

notes.title: Tracking ZX-1944
notes.text: Package tracking number ZX-1944 is late; the last scan was at the Cedar Mills depot.

notes.title: Lemon honey measure
notes.text: A cordial recipe adds 15 milliliters of lemon and 2 teaspoons of honey.

notes.title: Train times
notes.text: A train leaves platform 9 at 06:05 and arrives at 08:40.

notes.title: Winter's Tale typo
notes.text: A poster title should read A Winter's Tale, not A Winters Tale.

notes.title: Pepper diet
notes.text: Pepper's fictional diet is one cup of dry food at 7 a.m. and a carrot stick at noon. No chocolate.

notes.title: Garden shed paint
notes.text: The garden shed was painted sage green on 2026-04-20 and needs a second coat next month.

notes.title: Paper lanterns
notes.text: A festival box contains 12 paper lanterns stored on the hall shelf, unused.

notes.title: Cedar cutting board
notes.text: A cedar cutting board is priced at USD 18 in the weekend market stall, stall C3.

notes.title: Favorite saying
notes.text: Martin's favorite saying is: Let's try a smaller step.

notes.title: Town name
notes.text: The short story is set in the made-up town of Cedar Mills, not a real city.

notes.title: Blue crate aisle 4
notes.text: A blue crate of donated books is in aisle 4 of the library basement, not lost.

notes.title: Bakery mixer
notes.text: The bakery mixer at Hilltop Oven stopped 20 minutes before a Saturday sale; a manual whisk backup was used.

notes.title: Monday book gift
notes.text: Sam received the book The Night River on Monday.

notes.title: Council meeting typo
notes.text: A draft notice wrongly said Februry 31 in ceder Mills; the intended place is Cedar Mills.

notes.title: Folding table
notes.text: A folding table for the bake sale is stored behind the reference desk, six feet long.

notes.title: Rain plan
notes.text: If it rains on May 3, the bake sale moves to the reading room, not the lobby.

notes.title: Pepper leash
notes.text: Pepper's red leash hangs on the third hook by the back door.

notes.title: Blueberry supplier
notes.text: Blueberries for pancakes come from Willow Cart Farm, one pint each Friday.

notes.title: Quiet hours
notes.text: Cedar Mills public library has quiet hours from 18:00 to 19:00 on weekdays.

notes.title: Lost umbrella
notes.text: A green umbrella was left on bus 14 last Tuesday and is at the transit window.

notes.title: Map drawer
notes.text: The town walking-map reprints are in drawer C of the circulation desk.

notes.title: Piano tuner
notes.text: The community-room piano was tuned on 2026-02-11 by Rowan Gelt.

notes.title: Seed packets
notes.text: Six sunflower seed packets are in a tin labeled April, on the kitchen window ledge.

notes.title: Password reminder policy
notes.text: The fictional library staff must never store patron passwords on sticky notes.

notes.title: Chess night
notes.text: Friday chess night starts at 19:15 in the children's annex, bringing your own board is optional.

notes.title: Glue stock
notes.text: Acid-free glue sticks are on backorder; only 2 remain in the craft closet.

notes.title: River path closure
notes.text: The east river path is closed from the footbridge to the willow bench until 2026-08-01.

notes.title: Pepper birthday
notes.text: In the story, Pepper's birthday is July 9; the celebration is a walk, not cake.

notes.title: Audio kit
notes.text: A portable audio kit for story time is in bin A2, with 4 headphones.

notes.text: Mira Chen asked that the calendar plugin invoice be filed under software renewals, not hardware.

notes.title: Priya's garden query
notes.text: Priya Shah later asked whether a smaller gardening talk could replace the rejected workshop.

notes.title: Stargazing night

notes.title: Emergency number drill
notes.text: The library desk drill uses the fictional extension 717 for facilities, not a real emergency service.
